answer_1.quote: Generating a high-quality description of an image is not only an open research problem, but it is also a challenging task for humans.

answer_2.quote: We introduce two novel automated measures of caption quality, which directly address information retrieval. CLIP Recall... and Content Coverage...

answer_4.quote: To test the performance of our model in real-world conditions, we leverage human evaluations on the Amazon Mechanical Turk platform.
answer_4.guideline: Raters are asked to rate the 'Helpfulness' of the caption (on a scale of 0 to 4) and the 'Correctness' of the caption (on a scale of 0 to 5).
